slides.texte_overlay:
habits i wish i knew sooner
that made me ultra feminine

moving slowly

i started doing everything a little slower: walking, pouring tea, turning a page. slowness gives you a soft, magnetic grace that people notice immediately.

speaking softly

i lowered my voice and stopped rushing my words. people lean in to listen when your energy is calm, and every conversation starts to feel gentler and warmer.

unexpected stories

i always have a strange myth or a beautiful fact to share, and it makes me feel elegant and interesting in every conversation, at any dinner or party.
slides.texte_sophia:
unexpected stories

i always have a strange myth or a beautiful fact to share. i do it with the Sophia app, one lesson a day, and having unexpected stories makes me feel so elegant.

slides.texte_overlay:
protecting my peace

i stopped joining every drama around me. nothing feels more feminine to me than calmly choosing peace over chaos, again and again, every single day of my life.

little rituals

i turned boring chores into small rituals with candles, music and pretty cups. it makes ordinary days feel softer and makes me feel like the main character.
